title: Patriots for Europe Plan Delegation to Examine Detention of Ex-Ministers
detail: The Fidesz-linked Patriots for Europe group in the European Parliament said it would seek a plenary debate on the Hankó and Seszták cases and send a delegation to Hungary at the end of October to examine detention conditions of Hankó, Seszták and Balázs Bús.

media.caption: EP group to debate Hankó and Seszták cases
